heading: Introduction
content: # Frequently Asked Questions — LexTech Support

heading: What is LexTech?
content:
## What is LexTech?
LexTech is a cloud-based project management software that helps teams 
collaborate, track tasks, and manage deadlines in real time.

heading: How do I create an account?
content:
## How do I create an account?
To create a LexTech account:
1. Go to www.lextech.com/signup
2. Enter your work email address
3. Choose a password that is at least 8 characters long
4. Click the "Create Account" button
5. Check your email for a verification link and click it

heading: How much does LexTech cost?
content:
## How much does LexTech cost?
LexTech offers three pricing plans:
- Free Plan: Up to 3 users, 5 projects, 1GB storage
- Pro Plan: $12 per user per month, unlimited projects, 50GB storage
- Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing, unlimited everything, dedicated support

heading: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
content:
## Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your Account Settings 
page. Your access continues until the end of your current billing period. 
No refunds are given for partial months.

heading: Does LexTech work on mobile?
content:
## Does LexTech work on mobile?
Yes. LexTech has mobile apps for both iOS and Android. You can download them 
from the App Store or Google Play Store. All features available on desktop 
are also available on mobile.

heading: How do I contact support?
content:
## How do I contact support?
You can contact LexTech support in three ways:
- Live chat: Available 9am to 6pm EST Monday through Friday
- Email: support@lextech.com (response within 24 hours)
- Phone: 1-800-LEX-TECH (Enterprise plan customers only)

heading: Introduction
content: # New User Onboarding Guide — LexTech

heading: Welcome to LexTech!
content:
## Welcome to LexTech!
This guide will help you get started in your first 30 minutes.

heading: Step 1: Set Up Your Profile (5 minutes)
content:
## Step 1: Set Up Your Profile (5 minutes)
1. Click your avatar in the top right corner
2. Select "Edit Profile"
3. Add your full name, job title, and profile photo
4. Set your timezone so deadlines show correctly for you
5. Click Save

heading: Step 2: Create Your First Project (10 minutes)
content:
## Step 2: Create Your First Project (10 minutes)
1. Click the blue "New Project" button on your dashboard
2. Enter a project name and description
3. Choose a project color for easy identification
4. Set the project start date and deadline
5. Click "Create Project"

heading: Step 3: Invite Your Team (5 minutes)
content:
## Step 3: Invite Your Team (5 minutes)
1. Open your project
2. Click "Members" in the left sidebar
3. Click "Invite Member"
4. Enter your teammate's email address
5. Choose their role: Viewer, Editor, or Admin
6. Click Send Invite
Your teammate will receive an email invitation within 5 minutes.

heading: Step 4: Create Your First Task (10 minutes)
content:
## Step 4: Create Your First Task (10 minutes)
1. Inside your project, click "Add Task"
2. Enter the task name
3. Assign it to a team member
4. Set a due date
5. Add a priority level: Low, Medium, High, or Critical
6. Click Save

heading: User Roles Explained
content:
## User Roles Explained
- Viewer: Can see tasks but cannot edit anything
- Editor: Can create and edit tasks but cannot manage members
- Admin: Full access including member management and project settings
- Owner: The person who created the project, has all permissions

heading: Getting Help
content:
## Getting Help
If you get stuck at any point:
- Click the "?" icon in the bottom right corner for instant help
- Visit our help center at help.lextech.com
- Email support@lextech.com

heading: Introduction
content: # Refund Policy — LexTech

heading: Standard Refund Policy
content:
## Standard Refund Policy
LexTech offers a 14-day money-back guarantee for all new Pro Plan subscriptions.
If you are not satisfied within the first 14 days, contact support@lextech.com 
for a full refund. No questions asked.

heading: What is NOT refundable
content:
## What is NOT refundable
The following are not eligible for refunds:
- Subscriptions older than 14 days
- Enterprise plan setup fees
- Add-on purchases such as extra storage
- Accounts that violated LexTech Terms of Service

heading: How to Request a Refund
content:
## How to Request a Refund
1. Email support@lextech.com with subject line "Refund Request"
2. Include your account email and order number
3. Explain the reason for your refund request
4. Our team will process it within 5 business days
5. Refunds appear on your statement within 7-10 business days

heading: Refunds for Annual Plans
content:
## Refunds for Annual Plans
If you purchased an annual plan:
- Within 14 days: Full refund
- Between 14 and 30 days: 50% refund
- After 30 days: No refund, but you keep access until end of year

heading: Disputed Charges
content:
## Disputed Charges
If you see a charge you do not recognize, contact support@lextech.com 
immediately. We will investigate and respond within 48 hours.

heading: Introduction
content: # Security Policy — LexTech

heading: Password Requirements
content:
## Password Requirements
All LexTech passwords must meet these requirements:
- Minimum 8 characters long
- At least one uppercase letter
- At least one number
- At least one special character such as ! @ # $
- Cannot be the same as your last 5 passwords

heading: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
content:
## Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
LexTech strongly recommends enabling 2FA on all accounts.
Enterprise plan accounts have mandatory 2FA enforced by default.

To enable 2FA:
1. Go to Account Settings
2. Click Security
3. Click Enable Two-Factor Authentication
4. Choose SMS or Authenticator App
5. Follow the setup steps

heading: Data Encryption
content:
## Data Encryption
All data stored in LexTech is encrypted using AES-256 encryption.
All data transmitted between your browser and LexTech is encrypted using TLS 1.3.

heading: Session Management
content:
## Session Management
- Sessions automatically expire after 30 days of inactivity
- You can log out all devices from Account Settings → Security → Active Sessions
- If you suspect unauthorized access, change your password immediately and 
  contact security@lextech.com

heading: Reporting Security Issues
content:
## Reporting Security Issues
If you discover a security vulnerability in LexTech:
- Email security@lextech.com immediately
- Do not share the vulnerability publicly before we fix it
- We will respond within 24 hours and credit you in our security hall of fame

heading: Introduction
content: # Troubleshooting Guide — LexTech

heading: I cannot log into my account
content: ## I cannot log into my account

heading: Reason 1: Wrong password
content:
### Reason 1: Wrong password
If you forgot your password:
1. Go to www.lextech.com/login
2. Click "Forgot Password"
3. Enter your email address
4. Check your email for a reset link
5. Click the link and create a new password
The reset link expires after 30 minutes.

heading: Reason 2: Account locked
content:
### Reason 2: Account locked
Your account gets locked after 5 failed login attempts.
To unlock it, wait 15 minutes and try again, or contact support@lextech.com.

heading: Reason 3: Email not verified
content:
### Reason 3: Email not verified
If you just created your account, check your inbox for a verification email.
Check your spam folder if you do not see it.

heading: My dashboard is loading slowly
content:
## My dashboard is loading slowly

This usually happens because of one of these reasons:
- Too many browser tabs open — close unused tabs
- Slow internet connection — check your connection speed
- Browser cache is full — clear your browser cache and cookies
- Outdated browser — update your browser to the latest version

To clear cache in Chrome: Settings → Privacy → Clear Browsing Data → Cached Images and Files

heading: I cannot upload a file
content:
## I cannot upload a file

LexTech supports these file types: PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX, XLSX, CSV
Maximum file size is 25MB on Free plan and 100MB on Pro and Enterprise plans.

If your upload fails:
1. Check the file size is within your plan limit
2. Check the file type is supported
3. Try a different browser
4. If the problem continues, email support@lextech.com with error code ERR_UPLOAD_FAIL

heading: Two-factor authentication (2FA) is not working
content:
## Two-factor authentication (2FA) is not working

If you are not receiving your 2FA code:
1. Check that your phone number is correct in Account Settings
2. Wait 60 seconds and request a new code
3. Check your spam folder if using email 2FA
4. If using an authenticator app, make sure your phone clock is synced

To reset 2FA completely:
1. Contact support@lextech.com
2. Provide your account email and employee ID
3. Support will verify your identity and reset 2FA within 2 hours
